question: Under which of the following menu tabs are Page Setup options usually available in MS- Word 2007?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Page Layout.**__

__
 
• Page Setup options are usually available in Page Layout in MS- Word 2007.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The page setup is the parameters defined by the user that help determine how a printed page appears.
 
• These parameters can include everything from the size, margins, page orientation, and quality of the print.
 
• It's a tool that allows users to change and customize the size and layout of a single page or an entire document.
 
• [IMAGE: https://www.computerhope.com/jargon/p/page-setup-loc-msword.jpg] 
 
• [IMAGE: https://www.computerhope.com/jargon/p/page-setup.gif] 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Insert option** is used to insert the picture, charts, filter, hyperlink etc. 
 
• The** Excel Home Tab** is used to perform commands such as bold, underline, copy, and paste.
 
 
• It is also used to apply formats to cells in a worksheet.
 
 
 
• The** review tab** contains the editing feature, comments, track changes and workbook protection options.
